chunks: Whoever performs salat with an adhan and iqamah, two rows of angels perform salat behind him. And whoever performs salat with an iqamah without an adhan, one row performs salat behind him, and the extent of the row is what lies between the east and the west.

key_terms.أَذَانٍ: the call to prayer made before salat
key_terms.إِقَامَةٍ: the second call signaling the immediate commencement of salat
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةِ: the angels who pray behind the worshipper
key_terms.صَفَّانِ: two rows, referring here to rows of angels

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying with adhan and iqamah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the great merit of performing salat with both the adhan and iqamah. It highlights that doing so brings immense unseen honor, with rows of angels praying behind the worshipper, and even with iqamah alone there remains a significant virtue.
